answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 48749 Country: India Title: Dream Question: I usually see that I am going for Hajj or Umrah in my dreams. Recently I saw that I went for Umrah with my parents and while returning back I remember that I forgot to perform tawaf and qasr. I saw this while I was travelling. Answer ID: 48749 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1410/1410/M=11/1434) The dream in the journey indicates that you shall return home safe and sound. It is also blessed and good to see in dream going for hajj and Umrah. Whatever dream you had recently it warns that you are lagging behind in offering wajib acts. You need to pay special attention to it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
